source_refs.quote: We are two adults who enjoy art and architecture and prefer a moderate pace. Leave 14:00–16:00 on 2026-10-23, Paris local time, unscheduled for an online meeting. Do not schedule any activities or travel during that interval. The rest of our time is flexible.

groups.rationale: The complete original request prefers a moderate pace, mapped to ordinary. It specifies no exact daily primary-visit count. The protected interval on 2026-10-23 is only 14:00-16:00 Paris local time; it neither requests a rest day nor a different pace or visit count for that date. All four inclusive requested dates therefore retain ordinary with exact_count null and no dated overrides. The two adults and traveler_count 2 describe party size, not a sightseeing quota. Art and architecture are interests, not visit counts; the flexible remainder adds no count requirement.
